newsitem.title: USA: Sun City delays filing 10-K - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Sun City delays filing 10-K - spokesman.

text.p: A delay in filing the company's annual 10-K report with the Securities and Exchange Commission could be the reason for a trading halt in the company's stock, a spokesman for Sun City Industries Inc told Reuters.
"We didn't file a 10-K on time...that's probably the reason," the spokesman said.
He said that certain accounting issues had resulted in the delay, and added that the company was currently working to resolve them.
The company's stock opening was delayed on the American Stock Exchange.
The spokesman said he knew of no other developments that would explain the halt.
The 10-K report must be filed within 90 days after close of a company's fiscal year, according to SEC regulations.
